description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Failure' controller in the OpenCart ecommerce platform. It manages the output displayed to the user when a checkout process fails, constructing breadcrumb navigation and rendering a failure view.

classes.name: Failure
classes.description: Controller class handling the checkout failure page, extending the base Controller class in the Opencart system.
